string-array.name: charging_tips
string-array.item: Charge in a dry, ventilated place away from sun and heat, on a non-flammable surface.
Don\'t charge below about 0 °C or above 45 °C; let the battery reach room temperature after riding or the cold.
Use a charger made for your battery\'s chemistry and cell count: a Li-ion or lead-acid charger is not suitable for LiFePO₄.
Ideally the charger ends the charge (constant-voltage stage), not the BMS protection — see \"Recommended voltages\" in Alarms.
A charge current up to half the capacity (0.5C) is gentle on the cells; higher is faster but warmer.
Charge to 100 % at least once a week so balancing can work; cells only balance near full.
Don\'t leave the battery empty; recharge soon after a deep discharge.
For long storage leave it at 40–60 % and check it monthly.
Unplug the charger from the wall first, then from the battery; keep cables and connectors in good condition.
If the battery or charger gets unusually hot or smells, unplug immediately.
